title: Gintama
description: In a world where aliens have invaded Edo Period Japan, skyscrapers, trains and motor bikes have replaced the simple life of Earth inhabitants. One man however, still carries the soul of a samurai, Gintoki Sakata, otherwise known as Yorozuya Gin-san. As reckless as he is, Gintoki carries his own resolve and is ready to take on any challenge with his fellow companions.

episodes_data.description: In an effort to get some quick cash, Gintoki and Hasegawa, along with Shinpachi, Kagura, and Otae, head to the beach to get rid of a monster that's been terrorizing the area.

episodes_data.description: The Shinsengumi has been haunted by a mysterious being.

episodes_data.description:
Part 1 - The group helps an amanto to protect his pond from developers.

Part 2 - Gintoki goes all over town trying to find an electric fan replacement during a heatwave.

episodes_data.description: A female ninja stays over at the Yorozuya.

episodes_data.description: The series is entering into its third season! But the Yorozuya have other concerns: a battle of wits and deception to take reign of the sukiyaki pot!

episodes_data.description: The group goes to get Shinpachi's childhood friend out of a gang.

episodes_data.description: After Okita showed them an underground death match arena (Rengokukan), the group proceeds to track down the reigning champion of those death matches.

episodes_data.title: Gintama Season 1 Episode 28
episodes_data.description: A police department head official brings Kondo to a meeting to discuss the incident happened at the Rengokukan.

episodes_data.description:
Part 1 - An amanto goes around town to steal swords of value. Meanwhile Kagura steals Gintoki's wooden sword and tries to sell it.

Part 2 - Space cockroaches terrorize the town.

episodes_data.title: Gintama Season 1 Episode 30
episodes_data.description: Otsu receives a threat letter.  The trio goes to investigate.

episodes_data.title: Gintama Season 1 Episode 31
episodes_data.description: Gintoki has amnesia after a car accident.  His friends try to get his memory back.

episodes_data.title: Gintama Season 1 Episode 32
episodes_data.description: Gintoki who still does not have his memory back, works at a factory which produces a mysterious items.  Meanwhile, Shinpachi and Kagura goes to retrieve Gintoki.

episodes_data.title: Gintama Season 1 Episode 33
episodes_data.description: Sakamoto sends two amanto craftsmen to help rebuild the Yorozuya as repayment for him crashing his spaceship into the place.

episodes_data.title: Gintama Season 1 Episode 34
episodes_data.description: Shinpachi saves a girl with cat ears while on a train ride.  Later in a letter she sends him, the girl proceeds to ask him out.

episodes_data.description:
Part 1 - Shinpachi deals with the kitty-dressed thief.

Part 2 - Matsudaira gets Kondou, Hijikata, and Okita to help get his daughter to dump her boyfriend who he does not approve of.

episodes_data.title: Gintama Season 1 Episode 36
episodes_data.description: A colleague of Otae has been scammed of her money by a cult.  The Yorozuya and Otae goes to uncover the secret of the cult.

episodes_data.title: Gintama Season 1 Episode 37
episodes_data.description:
Part 1 - Gintoki meets Santa and has to help him deliver gifts.

Part 2 - Gintoki and Hattori fight over a year end double-issue of Jump (magazine).

episodes_data.description:
Part 1 - Everyone's participating in the neighborhood snow building contest-- with disastrous results.

Part 2 - An old man tries to get his wife to look at his fireworks & enjoy it.

episodes_data.title: Gintama Season 1 Episode 39
episodes_data.description: Katsura injures his leg while escaping from the Shinsengumi and uses a ramen shop as a temporary hideout.

episodes_data.description: Dissatisfied with Gintoki's reaction to Kagura's departure, Shinpachi quits and goes after Kagura.

episodes_data.description: Gintoki, along with Umibouzu, goes to combat the alien while at the same time avoiding the Shogunate's side of attack (on the alien).

episodes_data.title: Gintama Season 1 Episode 43
episodes_data.description:
Part 1 - Otae, Sa-chan, and Catherine all try to go for the series' heroine position.

episodes_data.description: Katsura, along with the Yorozuya, goes to find Sarutobi Ayame to train them on ninja skills in preparation for their Elizabeth rescue.

episodes_data.description: Sadaharu becomes a demon that the Yorozuya tries to rescue with the help of former priestess sisters.

episodes_data.description: Otae and Ane square off to keep their jobs by trying to out-earn each other.

episodes_data.description: The Yorozuya get a new neighbor, a frightening looking Amanto named Hedoro, and assume he's up to something.

episodes_data.description:
Part 1 - A group of assassins want to take Hijikata out. The problem: none of them really expected what would happen when he encountered Gintoki

Part 2 - Gintoki, Shinpachi and Kagura encounter an old man and are "forced" to play games with him; meanwhile, Sa-chan's master passed away and she went to attend his funeral.

episodes_data.title: Gintama Season 1 Episode 49
episodes_data.description: Gintoki and Hasegawa run into some gambling problems.

episodes_data.title: Gintama Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: The cast goes over their ideas for the series' new direction.

episodes_data.title: Gintama Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: A baby is dropped off in front of the Yorozuya with a note claiming it's Gintoki's son.

episodes_data.title: Gintama Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: It is revealed that the baby isn't Gintoki's; instead the baby was left at Yorozuya by the mother to keep her child safe from her father-in-law. Meanwhile Kagura and Shinpachi try to save the mother; Gintoki is on his way to return the baby.
